versions.changelog:
- Removed the "emoji" line from the skill metadata for simpler configuration.
- No functional or content changes to the skill instructions or description.
- Version number in the metadata remains at "1.0.0".

- Added new metadata fields: "clawdbot" with an emoji and homepage link.
- No functional or content changes to documentation or implementation.
- Version remains functionally identical to the previous release.

- Added a required step for explicit user consent before sending business details to Nansi via WhatsApp.
- Introduced a new privacy & data handling section outlining what information is shared, what is not, and how external messaging works.
- Updated agent instructions to confirm consent and clarify data handling before interacting with the Nansi WhatsApp service.
- Clarified that only user-provided business info is transmitted and never passwords or sensitive data.
- Included information and verification links to ensure user confidence in the service.

- Initial release of Nansi, a no-code, mobile-first AI website builder for WhatsApp.
- Enables users to create websites, portfolios, and web apps by describing their project via text or voice.
- No coding, design skills, or app downloads required—works entirely from your phone.
- Delivers a live website in under 2 minutes with instant preview and real-time edits.
- Free to start with daily limits; supports common website types for businesses, portfolios, and events.
